faq.heading: FAQs About Removing Gemini Watermarks
faq.intro: Learn what the tool can remove, which files it supports, and how your images are handled.

items.question: How do I remove a Gemini watermark from an image?
items.answer: Upload your Gemini image to WatermarkGemini, sign in with Google, start processing, and preview the cleaned area. If the result looks right, download the processed image.

items.question: Can I remove a Gemini watermark online?
items.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini works directly in your browser, so you can remove a visible Gemini watermark from supported image files without installing traditional photo-editing software.

items.question: Is the Gemini watermark remover free?
items.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini is free to use for supported images. Google sign-in is required before processing starts.

items.question: Can I turn off the visible watermark directly in Gemini?
items.answer:
Google has started rolling out a Media watermark setting that allows visible watermarks to be turned off for supported Gemini and Flow content.
Availability can vary by product, account, region, and local requirements. If the setting is unavailable or you already have an exported image with a visible mark, WatermarkGemini can be used to clean the visible watermark afterward.

items.question: What kind of Gemini watermark does this tool remove?
items.answer: WatermarkGemini is designed for visible Gemini marks appearing on image content. It does not claim to remove invisible provenance technologies such as SynthID or C2PA credentials.

items.question: Does removing the Gemini watermark crop the image?
items.answer: No cropping is required by the WatermarkGemini workflow. The tool processes the marked area instead of cutting away the corner of your image.

items.question: Will removing the Gemini watermark affect image quality?
items.answer: WatermarkGemini is designed to preserve the surrounding image while cleaning the visible mark. Results can vary depending on the watermark area and background complexity, so always check the preview before downloading.

items.question: Which image formats are supported?
items.answer: WatermarkGemini supports one JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB at a time.

items.question: Do I need to sign in?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose an image before signing in, but Google sign-in is required before processing begins.

items.question: Does WatermarkGemini remove SynthID?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini targets the visible image watermark only. It does not claim to remove Gemini's invisible SynthID watermark or other provenance information.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini affiliated with Google?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini is an independent image-cleanup tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

features.heading: A Gemini Watermark Remover Built for Clean Image Results

items.heading: Remove Gemini Watermark Without Cropping Your Image

Cropping out a corner watermark can cut away important subjects, backgrounds, or space you planned to use for text.
WatermarkGemini removes the visible Gemini mark from the image instead, helping you keep the original frame and composition intact.

WatermarkGemini cleans the visible mark while restoring the surrounding area so backgrounds such as skies, walls, textures, illustrations, and product surfaces look more natural.
